notes: Florida Insurance Examination Content Outlines effective January 1, 2026 (Pearson VUE publication 121003), Florida Adjuster's All Lines Insurance: 100 scored questions plus 10 pretest, 2 hours; I 14%, II 28%, III 28%, IV 15%, V 2%, VI 2%, VII 11%. Scaled to 50: 7/14/14/7/1/1/6 (V and VI share one category of 2; VII rounds up from 5.5 and IV down from 7.5). Pools are exactly 4x per-test counts, so no item repeats across tests. Content sets, not testSets: sets first, then tests.
